resources.string: An update is already running: step %1$d of %2$d · %3$s
Update started. Its progress is shown in the status line.

On: a refresh also updates the categories you hid. Off: hidden categories are left as they are — their films and series are not reloaded and their channels get no guide download — so the refresh is faster. Showing a category again brings it up to date on the next refresh. A playlist and its guide arrive as one file, so the saving is mostly on a portal.
